subject: Integrating Redwood as a vendor in GloBank AP portal — registration & PO format
messages:
From: Paula Li <paula.li@globank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@globank.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: GloBank vendor registration + PO/invoice formatting requirements

Hi Grace,

Thanks for speaking with our procurement team earlier. We're ready to get Redwood added as an approved supplier in GloBank's AP system. Attached is our standard AP vendor registration packet (GloBank_AP_Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf) — please complete and return. A few items to call out so our AP team can process quickly: 

1) Legal entity name + registered address (must match your VAT certificate).
2) VAT / tax identifier (EU VAT number) and a copy of the VAT registration certificate.
3) Banking details: IBAN, SWIFT/BIC and remit-to instructions for SEPA wires.
4) Wording/field expectations on invoices: PO number in header, line-level description, unit price, tax amount as a separate line, and a remit-to account ID field (we match to our internal remit code).
5) Preferred invoice file types: PDF preferred; we also ingest CSV/EDI for high-volume partners.
6) A contact for billing disputes and for portal user setup.

Could you return the completed packet and a sample invoice showing the PO number and VAT line? We also will invite your billing contact to our vendor portal (link included in the portal instructions). Once registered, our system will auto-validate invoices that match the PO/line format which speeds payment.

Thanks — aim is to get you into the portal this week if possible.

Best,
Paula Li
Senior AP Onboarding Lead
GloBank

Attachment: GloBank_AP_Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Paula Li <paula.li@globank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: GloBank vendor registration + PO/invoice formatting requirements

Paula — thanks for the clear checklist and packet. We're happy to proceed. Quick notes and items attached: Redwood_Bank_Details.pdf, Redwood_VAT_Registration_Certificate.pdf, Redwood_Sample_Invoice.xlsx.

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (registered office: 37 Harborview Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107; EU VAT: GB999999999)
- VAT certificate attached (Redwood_VAT_Registration_Certificate.pdf). If you need a country-specific VAT registration copy, let us know which EU jurisdiction you want on record and we'll pull it from finance.
- Banking: we support SEPA (IBAN) and SWIFT. Bank details are in Redwood_Bank_Details.pdf; remit-to account ID is included in the sample invoice under "RemitAccount" for your auto-matching.
- Invoice format: see attached sample. We can export a CSV/EDI feed if you prefer machine ingestion — our engineering team can map to the exact CSV columns your portal requires.

Action items on our side:
- I'll return the completed vendor packet within today.
- Looping in Dev (finance ops) and Marissa (contracts) to confirm there are no special legal terms we need to flag for PO-based billing.

If there's any specific header name or PO field formatting (e.g., PO number must be 12 digits or prefixed with GLB-), tell us and we'll adapt the invoice export.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Bank_Details.pdf; Redwood_VAT_Registration_Certificate.pdf; Redwood_Sample_Invoice.xlsx

From: Paula Li <paula.li@globank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@globank.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: GloBank vendor registration + PO/invoice formatting requirements

Thanks Grace — couple follow-ups from AP: 

- Our portal requires the PO number to appear in the invoice header field labelled "GLO-PURCHASE-ORDER" (exact string). If it is prefixed (e.g., GLB-123456), we accept either as long as the PO appears in that header.
- For EU vendors: we need the VAT number and VAT registration certificate. If you have an EU establishment or fiscal representative, please include that as well.
- Payments: we pay via SEPA for euro invoices. For USD invoices we can use SWIFT. Please confirm whether you want EUR invoices (SEPA) or USD (wire).
- Portal setup: we will send an invite to your billing contact; the portal supports CSV bulk uploads and a simple EDI/flat-file. I'll attach the portal instructions (GloBank_Portal_Instructions.pdf) and include the vendor portal invite link: https://portal.globank.com/vendor-registration/XYZ-portal-invite

If you can return the completed packet and sample invoice by EOD CET Wednesday, we can get the vendor ID created and test a sample invoice ingestion.

Best,
Paula

Attachment: GloBank_Portal_Instructions.pdf

Grace / Marissa — summarizing next steps so we don't miss anything: 

1) I will complete the GloBank_AP_Vendor_Registration_Form with the bank detail and VAT certificate attached. (action: Dev)
2) Finance will generate an EUR invoice example (SEPA) and a USD invoice (wire) so Procurement can test both flows; sample files will include the exact header string "GLO-PURCHASE-ORDER" and a RemitAccount field. (action: Dev)
3) Marissa, can you confirm whether the clause around invoice dispute timelines in our standard T&Cs (Net 30, 30-day disputes) needs to be modified for GloBank? Procurement sometimes requires 60-day dispute windows.
4) Grace, please accept the portal invite when it arrives and confirm the billing contact (we should use finance@redwood.com for the portal user).

I'll drop the completed packet and the two sample invoices into the shared drive and add the link here once uploaded. Planning ETA: uploaded by 2026-06-02T11:00:00-07:00.

—Dev Patel
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
